partner_result.applied_statement: For Q=2X1X2+2ZV with Z uniform on [1,2], V uniform on [0,1], an artificial N-cell partition of V gives K_eff,N=(12-8sqrt(2))N and the optimized absolute critical-Fourier certificate diverges.

new_results.statement: For independent cap-one X,Y, arbitrary shifts a,b, c!=0 and 1<=p<infinity, ||p_{2c(X-a)(Y-b)}||_p <= p |c|^{-1+1/p}.
For cap-one Z, arbitrary r and d!=0, ||p_{d(Z-r)^2}||_{3/2} <= 2 |d|^{-1/3}.

If an original-coordinate principal triple is [[0,c,0],[c,0,0],[0,0,d]], with arbitrary outside block/couplings, then ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= 6 |c|^{-2/3}|d|^{-1/3}; for |c|,|d|>=1 this is an exact-target branch with constant <=6.
For a direct sum of original-coordinate hyperbolic blocks [[0,c],[c,0]] and [[0,e],[e,0]], with arbitrary outside couplings, ||p_Q||_infinity <=4/sqrt(|ce|).

Any active original-coordinate density theorem uniform in all affine terms extends to arbitrary outside coordinates/couplings with the identical constant by conditioning on outside original coordinates.
